title: On-Policy Parameter Update Direction Underlies Generalization in LLM Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2609.36659v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The strong generalization performance of on-policy post-training paradigms has motivated studies of their parameter update behaviors. However, these studies treat the observed behaviors only as byproducts in on-policy training, overlooking their potential to serve as optimization principles for improving the generalization of other paradigms such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT). To address this limitation, we investigate whether there exists a specific on-policy update behavior that can achieve such improvements. First, our analyses reveal that SFT updates parameters along consistent directions, while the on-policy paradigm continuously adjusts the direction during training. This difference inspires us to focus on the cumulative update direction of each parameter as a promising behavior. translated_title: 在策略参数更新方向决定LLM后训练的泛化能力
translated_abstract: 在策略后训练范式的强泛化性能促使人们研究其参数更新行为。然而，这些研究仅将观察到的行为视为在策略训练的副产品，忽视了它们作为优化原则用于提升其他范式（如监督微调SFT）泛化能力的潜力。为解决这一局限，我们研究了是否存在某种特定的在策略更新行为能够实现这种改进。首先，我们的分析揭示出SFT沿着一致的方向更新参数，而在策略范式则在训练过程中持续调整更新方向。这一差异启发我们将每个参数的累积更新方向作为一个有前景的研究焦点。随后，我们通过提出在策略方向约束监督微调（On-Policy direction-constrained Supervised Fine-Tuning, OPSFT）来评估该行为在提升泛化能力方面的有效性。
tldr: 该论文揭示了SFT沿固定方向更新参数而在策略训练持续调整更新方向这一关键差异，并提出OPSFT方法将在策略方向约束机制引入监督微调，从而提升LLM的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the key difference that SFT updates parameters along consistent directions while on-policy training continuously adjusts update directions, and proposes OPSFT to incorporate on-policy direction constraints into supervised fine-tuning for improved LLM generalization.
